rationale: The original thesis remains intact — price is coiling in a tight 6-cent range above rising VWAP (31.82) and the 9-EMA (31.78), with higher closes into the offer (31.89→31.91) and just below the high-of-day, while max adverse excursion of only -0.02% shows no distribution. Volume decay in the flag is a caution flag, and the weak tape argues for restraint, but there is no structural break to justify closing, and certainly not enough evidence (price above VWAP at range highs on 54x RVOL) to justify flipping short. Risk to the $31.70 invalidation is ~$68, safely inside the $161 remaining loss budget, so the position stays on with the original stop.
